================================================================================
Firebird blocks: EXECUTE BLOCK with declarations
================================================================================

execute block as
declare x int;
begin
  x = 1;
  x = 2;
end;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: EXECUTE BLOCK with declarations and a select
================================================================================

execute block as
declare x int;
begin
  x = 1;
  x = 2;
end;
select 1 from rdb$database;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: EXECUTE BLOCK with RETURNS
================================================================================

execute block returns (n int) as
begin
  n = 1;
  suspend;
end;
select 1 from rdb$database;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: EXECUTE BLOCK with parameters and nested blocks
================================================================================

EXECUTE BLOCK (A INTEGER = ?) RETURNS (B INTEGER)
AS
  DECLARE VARIABLE I INTEGER;
  DECLARE VARIABLE J INTEGER;
BEGIN
  I = 0;
  WHILE (I < A) DO
  BEGIN
    I = I + 1;
    IF (I = 2) THEN
    BEGIN
      J = I;
    END
  END
  B = I;
  SUSPEND;
END;
SELECT 2 FROM RDB$DATABASE;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: a comment before EXECUTE BLOCK
================================================================================

/* a block */
-- that sets x
Execute
  Block As
Begin
  x = 1;
End;
select 1 from rdb$database;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: EXECUTE that is not EXECUTE BLOCK
================================================================================

EXECUTE PROCEDURE p;
EXECUTE STATEMENT 'select 1 from rdb$database';
SELECT block FROM t;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: a variable right after BEGIN and in a nested block
================================================================================

execute block as begin :body; end;
create procedure p returns (n int) as
begin
  select count(*) from rdb$database into :n;
  if (:n > 0) then
  begin
    :stmt;
  end
  suspend;
end;
select 1 from rdb$database;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: a character that is not in a word right after BEGIN
================================================================================

execute block as begin (select 1 from rdb$database); end;
create procedure p as begin 'x'; begin "y" = 1; end end;
create procedure q as begin -1; end;
select 1 from rdb$database;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement
    (string)
    (quoted_identifier))
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Firebird blocks: a byte order mark between EXECUTE and BLOCK
================================================================================

execute﻿block as declare x int; begin x = 1; end;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement))
